title: Einstein signs letter warning Roosevelt of atomic bombs
summary: Albert Einstein signed a letter drafted by Leo Szilard warning President Franklin D. Roosevelt that a uranium chain reaction could produce extremely powerful bombs and that Germany might build them.
reason: Nuclear fission had been discovered in Germany months earlier, and refugee physicists feared Hitler would gain such a weapon first.
significance: It led to the first American government research on uranium and, in time, to the Manhattan Project.
place: Nassau Point, Peconic, New York, United States
